posts.author: doller554
posts.body: Is there a way to turn a plugin on and off while the game is playing. What I am looking for is to turn on the ARGP plugin for a mini game I have, but use the regular RPG Maker MV system for the main game. Is there a way to do this?

posts.author: TheAM-Dol
posts.body:
doller554 said:
Is there a way to turn a plugin on and off while the game is playing.
Click to expand...
No.
Plugins are loaded in when creating a new game as basically "the engine"; you cannot strip part of it out mid way or things are going to crash.
That being said, depending on how the plugin is structured, it's possible to wrap the functions of the plugin in a conditional to check for a gameSwitch to enable or disable it's functionality.
Again; depends on the plugin in question and how it was written.
